signals.title: Tokens per sub-agent
signals.zeroMeans: this source has no sub-agents, or does not label them -- absent, not zero
signals.describe: Tokens spent inside a named sub-agent type.

signals.title: Cache-miss reason
signals.zeroMeans: no turn in the window stated a reason -- either the cache was hit or this source does not report one
signals.describe: The vendor's own reason a prompt could not be served from cache, from its closed vocabulary. A category label, never content.

signals.title: Context compactions
signals.zeroMeans: this source does not mark a context overflow -- absent, not a session that never overflowed
signals.describe: Times a session's context overflowed and was auto-summarized, counted from the tool's own boundary marker.

signals.title: Estimated cost
signals.zeroMeans: no priced usage -- a model absent from the price table is excluded, never counted as free
signals.describe: Tokens priced at public pay-as-you-go rates. Not your bill: a flat plan bills differently, and long-context rates are not modelled.

signals.title: Edit operations
signals.zeroMeans: this source records no edit activity -- absent, not zero
signals.describe: How many edit-type tool calls ran, regardless of how many lines each moved.

signals.title: AI lines added
signals.zeroMeans: this source records no edit activity -- absent, not zero
signals.describe: Added lines counted from the tool's own edit records. The code itself is never stored.

signals.title: AI lines removed
signals.zeroMeans: this source records no edit activity -- absent, not zero
signals.describe: Removed lines counted from the tool's own edit records.

signals.title: Declined tool calls
signals.zeroMeans: this source does not record a human declining a call -- absent, not a run nobody stopped
signals.describe: Tool proposals a person refused, counted only where a source records the refusal at all.

signals.title: Rework lines
signals.zeroMeans: no added line was undone later in the same transcript, or the source records no edits
signals.describe: Added lines a later edit in the same session removed again. A churn proxy; healthy iteration churns too.

signals.title: Focused minutes
signals.zeroMeans: no measurable gap-free activity
signals.describe: Time between turns with gaps over 30 minutes excluded, so a resumed session's idle time is not counted as work.

signals.title: Sessions
signals.zeroMeans: no sessions in the window
signals.describe: Distinct sessions seen. A resumed session keeps its id, so one session can span days.

signals.title: Tokens per skill
signals.zeroMeans: this source does not label turns with a skill -- absent from the split, not zero
signals.describe: Tokens the tool itself attributed to a named skill.

signals.title: Step outcome
signals.zeroMeans: no step in the window states how it ended, or this source marks no step outcomes -- the two are told apart by whether any sequence is stored at all
signals.describe: How one step ended, from a closed vocabulary of ok, error, denied and truncated. An unstated outcome is its own value and is never read as ok.

signals.title: Step target
signals.zeroMeans: no step in the window named a file, or the call naming it could not be read -- absent, not a session that touched nothing
signals.describe: The integer standing for the file a step acted on, assigned in first-seen order within one sequence. Comparable only inside that sequence, and never a path or a digest of one: "the same file nine times" stays answerable while "which file" stays unanswerable.

signals.title: Sequence steps
signals.zeroMeans: this source records no ordered sequence -- absent, not a session that did nothing
signals.describe: Observations in a session's own order: model turns and tool calls, each with its position. Content-free -- no prompt, no code, no file name.

signals.title: Cache-read tokens
signals.zeroMeans: nothing was served from the prompt cache -- real for one-shot work
signals.describe: Prompt tokens billed at the cache-read rate.

signals.title: Cache-write tokens
signals.zeroMeans: nothing was written to the prompt cache
signals.describe: Prompt tokens billed at the cache-write rate; wasted when never read back.

signals.title: 1-hour cache-write tokens
signals.zeroMeans: this source does not report the cache lifetime a write bought, or every write was the 5-minute tier -- the two are indistinguishable here
signals.describe: The portion of cache-write tokens that bought a 1-hour cache lifetime, billed at its own higher rate. A subset of cache-write, never added to a total.

signals.title: Input tokens
signals.zeroMeans: no billable usage in the window
signals.describe: Uncached prompt tokens. Claude's own figure can be a streaming placeholder, so totals may drift from the vendor console.

signals.title: Output tokens
signals.zeroMeans: no billable usage in the window
signals.describe: Tokens the model produced, including any reasoning portion.

signals.title: Reasoning tokens
signals.zeroMeans: this source does not report reasoning separately -- not that none was spent
signals.describe: The thinking portion already counted inside output, for the sources that surface one.

signals.title: Total tokens
signals.zeroMeans: no billable usage in the window
signals.describe: Input, output and both cache directions summed. Reasoning is inside output and never re-added.

signals.title: Tool calls
signals.zeroMeans: this source does not name its tool calls -- absent, not zero
signals.describe: Every tool invocation in a turn, split by purpose where the source names them.

signals.title: Failed tool calls
signals.zeroMeans: this source does not mark call outcomes -- absent, not a clean run
signals.describe: Calls that came back an error, counted only where a source marks the outcome of every call.

signals.title: Turns
signals.zeroMeans: no turns recorded -- a session-total source contributes none
signals.describe: Model requests. A source that totals a whole session cannot contribute here, which is what turn-level coverage reports.

gaps: no ordered step sequence is read from its logs yet, so the behaviour detectors have nothing to read for it
no cache-write counter, so a written cache is invisible where a read one is not
no skill or sub-agent labels, so its turns are absent from the attribution split
tool-use denials are not recorded, and call failures only for file edits
no ordered step sequence, so the behaviour detectors exclude it
no line, edit or tool-call signals, so it contributes cost but no output figures
no cache-write counter, so a written cache is invisible where a read one is not
tool-use tokens are folded into output, and ~/.gemini may be shared with other tools
no ordered step sequence: a whole-session total has no order to record
totals exist only when a session ends, so one record covers a whole session and per-turn figures exclude it
code changes are counted once per session with no per-model split, so they are credited whole to the model that made the most requests
no ordered step sequence, so the behaviour detectors exclude it
no line, edit or tool-call signals, so it contributes cost but no output figures
its own per-request cost is recorded but recomputed from tokens for cross-tool consistency
no token counter of any kind: every token and cost figure withholds its verdict for it rather than counting a zero

no model name -- the one the vendor keeps sits in an unnamed protobuf field of a live SQLite database, on 218 of 500 captured conversations and several per conversation with nothing to choose between them
no working directory, so its sessions carry no project and are absent from every per-project figure
no changed-line, rework or compaction counter
no ordered step sequence: the transcript is ordered, but the captured corpus holds 26 tool calls across 500 conversations, so there is nothing for the behaviour detectors to read

delegation is unverified rather than absent: the vendor's has_subtrajectory column is false on all 1,975 steps of the captured corpus, which cannot separate 'no sub-agent ran' from 'this build never sets it', so this source claims neither

validators.name: adoption
validators.title: Adoption & Usage Breadth
validators.describe: Sessions, active days, and project/tool breadth: how broad AI usage is, and whether it's growing.

validators.name: burn-anomaly
validators.title: Burn Anomaly
validators.describe: Days whose token burn stands far outside this window's typical day.

validators.name: cache-hygiene
validators.title: Cache Hygiene
validators.describe: Prompt-cache reuse: how much billed input was served from cache vs re-sent, which lifetime the writes bought, and why a miss happened.

validators.name: concentration
validators.title: Spend Concentration
validators.describe: How token spend spreads across projects, and whether the heaviest spenders produced output to match.

validators.name: context
validators.title: Context Health
validators.describe: Conversation depth, peak context size, active time, and how often sessions hit compaction.

validators.name: coverage
validators.title: Coverage & Confidence
validators.describe: How much of this window is high-confidence data: the share of tokens from tools with full activity capture, and the share priced.

validators.name: edit-loops
validators.title: Repeat Edits
validators.describe: How often a file goes back for another pass after a command ran, and which sessions stand far outside this window's own rate.

validators.name: explore-produce
validators.title: Explore vs Produce
validators.describe: What the tool calls were for: reading and searching the codebase versus writing code in it.

validators.name: friction
validators.title: Friction
validators.describe: How often tool calls fail outright, beside how often a human declines one.

validators.name: intent
validators.title: Task Intent Coverage
validators.describe: How much of the window carries a task label, and whether that is enough to read any other metric per kind of work.

validators.name: model-fit
validators.title: Model Fit
validators.describe: Premium vs. cheaper model token share, lines-per-token contrast, and real sub-agent delegation share.

validators.name: model-right-sizing
validators.title: Model Right-Sizing
validators.describe: Turns on a premium model that produced very little output -- small tasks a cheaper, faster model might handle just as well.

validators.name: reasoning-share
validators.title: Reasoning Share
validators.describe: How much generated output is extended-thinking (reasoning) tokens, among tools that report it.

validators.name: recovery
validators.title: Failure Recovery
validators.describe: What a failed call, a refusal or a lost context costs next: the turns that follow one, against what a turn costs anywhere else in the window.

validators.name: rework
validators.title: Rework & Rejection
validators.describe: Within-session code churn and human tool-call rejections -- a directional friction proxy.

validators.name: rhythm
validators.title: Work Rhythm
validators.describe: When AI sessions run -- the off-hours and weekend share -- and how long the longest focused sessions last.

validators.name: session-taxonomy
validators.title: Session Taxonomy
validators.describe: What kind of work sessions are: conversational (no edits), light-edit, or heavy-edit, and how the mix splits.

validators.name: skill-economics
validators.title: Skill & Agent Economics
validators.describe: Which skills and sub-agents the tokens went to, and how much code each produced.

validators.name: subscription-fit
validators.title: Subscription Fit
validators.describe: Whether a flat monthly plan (Claude Max/Pro, ChatGPT Plus/Pro) pays off vs API pay-as-you-go, from your configured plan cost.

validators.name: throughput
validators.title: Throughput
validators.describe: Total AI-added lines, lines per active day, top projects by lines, and the week-over-week trend.

validators.name: turn-efficiency
validators.title: Turn Efficiency
validators.describe: Getting more per prompt: one-shot rate, median turns per code-producing session, and output tokens per turn.
